title: The Clockwork Witness
subtitle: Extra · Player-owned recording automaton · original extra proposal

fields.label: Permission / cost
fields.value: Ownership and workshop access establish permission. One stunt slot buys the recording capability below; paid slots follow normal refresh costs. It is not free additional power for Ira.

fields.label: Aspect
fields.value: It Remembers Exactly What It Was Shown

fields.label: Capability
fields.value: A fist-sized brass moth records a continuous ten-minute sound-and-image sequence from its physical perch. Its owner can replay the record; appropriate Investigate actions may create advantages from it.

fields.label: Limits / operation
fields.value: No autonomous skill rolls, independent turns, remote teleportation or concealed-thought recording. Moving it into a guarded position uses the owner's relevant skill and takes the owner's action when an action is required.

fields.label: Complication / counterplay
fields.value: It is audible at close range and can be covered, stolen or misdirected. A truthful recording can still omit the decisive event outside its view.

fields.label: Availability
fields.value: One is held as evidence in the Office vault. Acquiring it is fiction; gaining the proposed ongoing ability also needs the agreed character-resource cost.
